steps.code:
import random
import re

content = funny_note['content']
# Extract quotes: lines starting with " - " and ending with "by ..."
quotes = []
for line in content.split('\n'):
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Remove leading "- "
        quote_part = line[2:]
        # Remove "by Author" at the end
        match = re.match(r'^(.*?)\s+by\s+.*$', quote_part)
        if match:
            quotes.append(match.group(1).strip())
        else:
            quotes.append(quote_part)

random_quote = random.choice(quotes)
print(random_quote)
